spec_family.name: New Construction Full Prime - Ceilings and Walls, Pre-Trim
spec_family.description: Prime coat application for bare drywall ceilings and walls in new construction. Scope covers both surfaces primed together before trim installation. Includes protection of windows, exterior doors, recessed lighting, and electrical boxes. No floor protection (subfloor only). No edge work required (same coat on ceilings/walls, no trim installed).

includes: Bare drywall ceiling surfaces (taped, mudded, sanded)
Bare drywall wall surfaces (taped, mudded, sanded)
excludes: Edge work (not required - same coat on all surfaces, no trim)
Floor protection (subfloor only - no finished flooring)
Fastener spot-priming (galvanized screws do not rust in normal timeline)

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier governing prep intensity, material grade, and inspection discipline
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT5 unlikely for prime-only scope; QT2 is minimal economy work
Spray+backroll is NC production standard; roll for smaller jobs; spray-only for economy

configuration_dimensions.description: Drywall finish level per GA-214 standard
configuration_dimensions.notes: Level 3 = tape/compound only; Level 4 = additional skim; Level 5 = full skim

configuration_dimensions.description: Wall/ceiling surface texture (if applied before priming)
configuration_dimensions.notes: Texture affects coverage rate and application technique

protection_items.name: Window Opening Masking
protection_items.notes: Mask with plastic film, tape perimeter of rough opening

protection_items.name: Exterior Door Masking
protection_items.notes: Mask exterior doors in place; interior door openings are rough framing only

protection_items.name: Room Fixture Protection (Lights + Electrical)
protection_items.counting_rules: Source from PaintScope PS_META.EA.ROOMS_TOTAL; heuristic: 4-8 recessed lights + 8-12 electrical boxes per room
protection_items.notes: Stuff recessed cans and electrical boxes with paper, tape over face

protection_items.name: Building Materials/Tools Covering
protection_items.notes: Cover materials and tools in work area with plastic sheeting

variants.notes: Standard NC production method - spray+backroll with full protection
Standard spray-only where backroll not required
Economy roller - no protection needed (no overspray)
Standard roller application - materials cover only

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Floor area for subfloor vacuum tasks (pre-prime and post-prime cleanup)
Count of window openings to mask
Count of exterior door openings to mask
Room count for fixture and electrical box protection heuristic

valid_input_states.notes: Full NC prime operates on bare new drywall (both ceilings and walls)

output_state.notes: Full prime produces field-primed state on both surfaces

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: Both surfaces being primed together — no protection needed at ceiling-wall junction

sequencing_notes.surface_sequence: Ceilings FIRST, then Walls. Gravity drip management.
sequencing_notes.edge_work: NONE REQUIRED - same primer coat on both surfaces, no trim installed
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Protect openings → Protect fixtures/electrical → Cover materials → Apply primer (ceilings then walls)
sequencing_notes.wet_edge: Maintain wet edge at ceiling-wall transition to prevent lap marks

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial spec for NC full prime (ceilings + walls, pre-trim). Removed floor protection (subfloor only), removed fastener spot-priming (galvanized screws do not rust), changed fixture protection to room-based heuristic.
